description: Official hosted MCP server for varg.ai: generate AI video, images, speech and music with Kling, Seedance, Veo, Sora, Flux, ElevenLabs and 90+ other models from one account, estimate costs, check balance, poll jobs and fetch result files.

notes: Hosted endpoint uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration (scopes: email offline_access); no API key needed.
The stdio package @vargai/mcp uses VARG_API_KEY from Settings -> API Keys instead of OAuth.
Paid plans from $24/month; there is no free tier.

clients: any MCP client supporting Streamable HTTP
license: MIT (npm package @vargai/mcp); hosted service itself is proprietary
